explication: Microsoft Agent Framework is a multi-language framework for production AI agents and multi-agent workflows. An application submits a request through a hosting endpoint or directly to an agent runtime; the runtime applies middleware, invokes a provider, optionally orchestrates a workflow, persists sessions or checkpoints, and returns a response or stream. The README also documents declarative agents, DevUI, observability, provider flexibility, and durable workflow patterns. Several relationships below follow documented capabilities; sampled source most directly confirms storage, compaction, expression evaluation, embeddings, and hosting components.
